hero.title: Iungo Resolve
hero.presentation: An L1/L2 support agent with deep knowledge of your product.
hero.description: It reads the Iungo Organizer AI PIM catalog in real time. It checks the Iungo Behavior CDP profile. It resolves technical questions like a specialist — in seconds.
hero.imageAlt: Iungo Resolve illustration with service flows and connected modules.

automatedResolution.complement: with no handoff to a human

differentials.title: Why Iungo Resolve sees what Zendesk and Intercom do not.
differentials.subtitle: Not another chatbot trained on an FAQ. An agent plugged into the live data of your operation.

catalog.title: A live catalog via Iungo Organizer AI PIM
catalog.description: Every answer is grounded in the technical sheet, attributes, compatibility, and current stock. Zero product hallucination.

profile.title: 360° profile via Iungo Behavior CDP
profile.description: It knows if the customer is VIP, the last purchase, and the preferred category. It personalizes tone and recommendation.

handoff.title: Human handoff with full context
handoff.description: When it escalates, the agent gets a ready briefing: history, intent, sentiment, and next best action.

channels.title: Native multi-channel
channels.description: WhatsApp Business, web chat, email, Instagram DM. The same intelligence, the same conversation memory, the same customer.

citations.title: Verifiable citations
citations.description: Every answer links to the source (PDP, policy, manual). Auditable, in PT-BR, in your brand voice.

learning.title: It learns from every ticket
learning.description: It detects recurring questions and suggests PIM updates. The catalog improves on its own with every interaction.

systemScreens.title: The console the CX supervisor watches all day.
systemScreens.description: Operations console, PIM training, quality metrics, and handoff supervision.

alts.main: Iungo Resolve console with live conversations and service indicators.
alts.training: PIM training with product FAQs and answers grounded in the catalog.
alts.quality: Quality assurance panel with FAQ review and approval status.
alts.supervision: Supervision and handoff panel with conversations in transfer and service status.

testimonials.title: CX that grows without inflating headcount.
testimonials.description: Service leaders who automated L1/L2 without losing quality or CSAT.

renata.quote: The human team now takes only what matters: a hard case, an upset VIP, a systemic issue. Iungo Resolve absorbed the flood of ‘what size?’ and ‘is it in stock?’ — and CSAT went up, not down.
renata.name: Renata D.
renata.role: Head of CX · Marketplace · under NDA

felipe.quote: What I sold internally was the number of tickets resolved without a human. What I actually bought was the handoff briefing: when the agent passes it to me, I already know everything. I do not ask the customer twice.
felipe.name: Felipe N.
